description: Remove a masked object from an image (white in the mask = remove) and fill the gap. Needs the source and a mask of the same size, each a local file, a public https URL or an Ideogram asset. Results are saved to the output directory; ideogram_quote prices a call first (nothing is generated).

image.description: Local image file to work on, or a public https URL of one

image_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset (an upload or an earlier result) instead of a local image

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

mask.description: Local mask image file or a public https URL, the same size as the source

mask_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset to use as the mask

model.description: The model (default ideogram-1); each takes the fields of its variant below

seed.description: Random seed for a reproducible result

store_assets.description: Keep the result on Ideogram as an asset (accepted by the API, not yet enforced by it)

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (0-50, default 45). The job is accepted first; if it is still running when the wait ends, the result is its generation_id for ideogram_generation (never resubmitted, never billed twice).

name: ideogram_remove_object
title: Remove an object from an image
